blurb:
The contributions made by women in history are often overlooked. This tour focuses on some of the women who shaped New Orleans's architectural and cultural history on this three hour walking tour. Explore 1 1/2 miles of the famous French Quarter while a local, native guide details the amazing stories of the influential women who preserved, advocated for, and fought for the modern city of today.
